column4: The inactive sync model no longer marks a newer edit or deletion as acknowledged when only an older same-millisecond update was accepted.
Added same-millisecond edit, deletion, tombstone replacement, device identity and save/reload acknowledgement checks.
Recorded TEST111 delivery and published the owner's hour-by-hour evidence PDF without rebuilding the app or inventing work time.

I corrected acknowledgement handling in the future preference-sync model and retained its pending edits across restart. Online functionality remains inactive; current gameplay and raw history are unchanged.
